name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Housing for all - provides financial assistance for construction of pucca houses to eligible beneficiaries
benefits: Subsidy of ₹1.2-2.5 lakh for house construction

eligibility.income: Annual income below ₹3 lakh (EWS) or ₹3-6 lakh (LIG)
eligibility.other: Should not own a pucca house anywhere in India

name: PM-KISAN
description: Income support to all farmer families with cultivable land

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
description: Health insurance coverage for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization
benefits: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year
